purpose: Evaluate Tessellum's digestion pipeline (plan -> augment -> review -> execute) against real golden triples produced by the SAME four skills, run at scale in a production vault.

framing.why_this_is_a_valid_golden: The reference plans and notes were produced by the identical four digestion skills that Tessellum's composer runs as tessellum.composer.digestion.run_digestion_pipeline (PHASE_SKILLS = plan_digestion, augment_digestion_plan, review_digestion_plan, execute_digestion_plan). So this is a same-pipeline reproduction test: feed Tessellum the same raw docs, and its generated plan + notes should match the golden's measurable structure (schema, BB atomicity, section coverage, cross-reference floors, density caps, gate outcomes).
framing.what_it_is_not: Not a byte-for-byte match test. Digestion is generative; the golden fixes the STRUCTURE and MEASURABLE CONTRACTS (counts, distributions, schema conformance, coverage, floors), and an LLM-judge rubric scores content fidelity against the source. Prose will differ run-to-run.

full_corpora.note: The complete triples originate in a private knowledge vault (git 59bdae36c). As of 2026-07-31 the FULL corpora are ALSO vendored here (see full_corpora_vendored below): each of the three sources ships its complete input_docs/ + golden_plans/ + golden_notes/ + golden_terms/ + golden_facts.json, deterministically scrubbed for this public repo. The three curated SLICES (curated_slices below) remain as focused single-sub-plan exemplars. Scrub (see full_corpora_vendored.scrub_policy for the authoritative detail): internal paths -> vault, private DB -> vault_unified.db, private skill-command names -> /tessellum-*, the whole cross-reference tail dropped from full-corpus notes, internal product/path/domain tokens in plans redacted to generic equivalents, internal related_wiki nulled, internal prose passages semantically removed from public-concept term bodies, and 5 wholly-internal term notes excluded.

full_corpora_vendored.note: The three full corpora vendored in-repo as self-contained subdirectories (added 2026-07-31), enlarging the eval from one curated slice per source to the whole digestion output. Each <corpus>/ holds input_docs/ (raw public third-party mirror, verbatim) + golden_plans/ (every sub-plan) + golden_notes/ (every note; bodies verbatim, internal cross-ref bullets stripped) + golden_terms/ (the term notes the campaign AUTHORED, public-subject only) + golden_facts.json (corpus-level, regenerated by tools/make_golden_facts.py from the scrubbed notes, so self-consistent). Score any corpus with: python score.py <corpus> --notes <corpus>/golden_notes.
full_corpora_vendored.produced_by: tools/vendor_full_corpora.py (deterministic scrubber, validated against the 3 hand-scrubbed curated slices as its correctness oracle) + tools/make_golden_facts.py.

scrub_policy.golden_notes_bodies: verbatim (verified: 0 internal product tokens in any note body); a rare vault-author editorial section that maps the public topic onto the source vault's private domain is dropped; generic vault-framing prose is neutralized to public knowledge-base language
scrub_policy.golden_notes_tails: the entire cross-reference tail (## Related Notes / ## References) is DROPPED for full-corpus notes — it is the largest leak surface (relevance clauses referencing the source vault's private neighbor notes) and only supplies the cross-ref-floor test dimension, which the 3 curated slices retain. The trailing **Source**/**Last Updated**/**Status** footer is kept. required_h2 for full corpora is therefore ['Overview'] (measured), not ['Overview','Related Notes'].
scrub_policy.golden_plans: mechanical (private skill-command names -> public /tessellum-* equivalents, private path/DB -> vault) + internal cross-ref bullets deleted + vault-search-narration dropped + residual internal product/path/domain tokens redacted to generic public equivalents
scrub_policy.golden_terms: AUTHORED terms only (git-attributed to each corpus digestion), public-CONCEPT subject only. Deterministic scrub handles the cross-ref tail + internal related_wiki; internal PROSE PASSAGES inside otherwise-public term bodies (e.g. an 'at Amazon, …' paragraph naming internal orgs/tools) were semantically removed per-term. 3 terms whose SUBJECT is itself an internal product plus 2 whose body is wholesale-internal were EXCLUDED entirely.
scrub_policy.verification: two independent scanners (deterministic regex + adversarial multi-agent audit, 9 + 65 agents) → 0 internal domains / products / programs / phrases / skill-names / private-paths / vault-framing. Residual scan hits are confirmed PUBLIC: 'Kiro' (publicly-announced AWS IDE, verbatim in upstream Claude Code + OpenClaw docs) and 'DKS' (Tessellum's own architecture pillar). 12-digit hits are public doc placeholders (RFC-4122 example UUIDs, Discord permission bitmasks, Ofcom fictional phones). Self-consistency GREEN with bb_similarity 1.0 and tier-2 mean 1.0 for all 3 corpora; the 3 curated slices remain GREEN with tails intact.

scoring.content_fidelity: LLM-judge 6-dim rubric (relevance, completeness, accuracy, clarity, structural_integrity, epistemic_congruence) — reuses tessellum.composer.eval.LLMJudge against the named source page(s).

split_protocol.dev: Development slices: may be read, swept, and tuned against. The learning objective computed on dev slices is a training objective, never a generalization claim.
split_protocol.test: Sequestered test slices: vendored mechanically (no developer read the content), never swept during development, scored only at declared release points. A test slice is CONSUMED by its first measured contact — after publication of its score it converts to dev. First-contact scores on test slices are the program's only generalization estimates (FZ 20m1a Stage 0; FZ 20m1 acceptance criterion 1).
